name: Due soon reminder (digest)
subject: [% IF checkouts.size == 1 %]1 library item is[% ELSE %][% checkouts.size %] library items are[% END %] due soon
about: Sent by advance_notices.pl a chosen number of days before the due date: one message listing every item, to a patron who chose 'Advance notice' with 'Digests only'. Each entry of checkouts is a plain row of the loan, its item and its title (checkout.title, checkout.barcode, checkout.date_due), not a Koha object, so checkout.item or checkout.overdue_fines print nothing here.
